usage: tr thesis [-h] [--session SESSION] [--analysis ANALYSIS]
                 [--arm {champion,challenger,teacher}] [--prompt PROMPT]
                 [--model MODEL] [--teacher MODEL] [--max-usd MAX_USD]
                 ticker

positional arguments:
  ticker

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --session SESSION
  --analysis ANALYSIS   analysis id (default: the newest for the ticker-day
                        and arm)
  --arm {champion,challenger,teacher}
  --prompt PROMPT       prompt version: prompts/<version>.txt
  --model MODEL
  --teacher MODEL       the teacher arm's model, pinned to its DeepInfra
                        endpoint: deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro,
                        qwen/qwen3.5-397b-a17b, openai/gpt-oss-120b
  --max-usd MAX_USD
